heritage.hcd_count_note: The City publishes no current total and its sources disagree. A collapsed FAQ on toronto.ca still says 27; the same page's table lists 24 rows, several bundling separately designated districts (Cabbagetown 4 plans, Rosedale 2, Harbord Village 2), giving 29 individual districts. The 27 traces to a staff report dated 2024-12-13, before Teiaiagon-Baby Point (2024-12-18) and Kensington Market (By-law 94-2025). CONSUMER PAGES MUST NOT RENDER A PRECISE COUNT: 29 is derived, and a reader checking toronto.ca will see 27. Render the display string instead. The exact number does not change the advice.
heritage.alteration_note: Properties inside a Heritage Conservation District are designated under Part V of the Ontario Heritage Act. Certain alterations and renovations — each district's HCD Plan spells out which — require a heritage permit from the City; proposals to alter a building in an HCD are reviewed by Heritage Planning as part of the building permit application (City of Toronto Heritage Permit Guide).
